calculation.transition: harmonic vacuum to the softest one-quantum mode
calculation.method: apply V4 exactly as four sparse ladder operations for each of 24 compact coordinates, then sum every nondegenerate Rayleigh-Schrödinger second-order denominator
calculation.scaling: at fixed u=1, the first-order gap correction scales as U and the second-order gap correction as U^(3/2)

crossChecks.parity: V4 connects the even vacuum only to even 0/2/4 sectors and the odd one-quantum source only to odd 1/3/5 sectors

interpretation: the leading virtual contribution of all 24 modes is explicitly finite and small in the declared semiclassical window; the dominant gap term is the difference between excited three-quantum and ground two-quantum channels
established: all 24-mode quartic virtual states contributing through second order to the softest transition have been enumerated and summed
boundary: This is nondegenerate second-order perturbation theory in the quartic Taylor term. It omits the sextic first-order contribution at the same U^(3/2) scaling, mixed quartic-sextic and higher orders, compact interwell tunnelling, dissipation and the thermodynamic coupled-wire limit. It is not by itself a controlled second-order expansion of the full cosine until the sextic term is added.
epistemicStatus: exact finite perturbative sum for V4 across all 24 modes; full-cosine order consistency remains open
